text: APPROVE: The extraction moves the `all:` stripping, the `..`/empty and empty-resolved skips, and the `isTree` computation unchanged into `TryBuildGoEmbedRef`, so behaviour is preserved. The `continue` statements become `return false`, the loop keeps only a single `if`, and the complexity of `CollectGoEmbedRefs` drops well below 15. The `default!` initialisation of the `out` parameter should not raise a nullable warning. I could not check that `rel` and `directory` are `string`, which the new signature assumes.
